findings.claim: An explicitly unsupported outside-source assertion still passes verification and can survive two-reader agreement and scorer replay. Declaring this a residual does not enforce C3's source-only requirement.
findings.guidance_basis: C3 prohibits unseen-source reliance. [Handbook 8.2.3](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08) requires circumstances supporting a reasonable probability judgement; a quoted omission supplies none.
findings.failing_test: Only source/quote: 'Randomisation details were omitted.'; 1.2 PY; rationale: 'The original manuscript confirms randomisation was concealed.' -> NI. Currently PY.

findings.claim: The 4.3 topic gate rejects contextual awareness inferred from distinguishable interventions and participant-reported outcomes. The repeated out-of-A2-scope decline leaves this guidance conflict unresolved.
findings.guidance_basis: [RoB 2 guidance](https://www.cochrane.de/sites/cochrane.de/files/uploads/RoB_2.0_guidance_2019.pdf), section 7.1 and question 4.3: participants assess participant-reported outcomes; distinguishable surgical and nonsurgical treatments can establish awareness.
findings.failing_test: 4.3 PY; quote: 'Participants received surgery or physiotherapy and rated their own pain.'; rationale: 'Participants can distinguish surgery from physiotherapy when rating pain.' -> retain PY. Currently NI.

findings.claim: The final assertion wrongly requires NI solely because a grounded concealment rationale contains 'commonly'. The USUAL filter confuses inference from a reported mechanism with unsupported assumptions about trials generally.
findings.guidance_basis: [Handbook 8.2.3](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08) permits reasonable contextual PY/PN. [RoB 2 question 1.2](https://www.cochrane.de/sites/cochrane.de/files/uploads/RoB_2.0_guidance_2019.pdf) recognizes centrally administered allocation mechanisms.
findings.failing_test: Existing SRC and QUOTE; 1.2 PY; rationale: 'central web-based randomisation is commonly concealed' -> retain contextual PY, not the test's NI.

findings.claim: The round-14 guard treats any earlier undecodable prose brace as proof that a later prose mention of 'answers' belongs to a broken object. Combining two individually supported prose forms therefore voids a valid reading.
findings.guidance_basis: SIGNING_A2.md part 1 promises to ignore surrounding prose. C4 must not lose a readable reader and its decision because of unrelated prose punctuation.
findings.failing_test: parse_reply('Note {draft}. The field "answers": holds rows.\n' + json.dumps(REPLY)) -> REPLY. Currently None.

findings.claim: Closed-branch contextual decisions remain invisible: rendering ignores both closed_contextual and contextual_audit. The A2 storage test does not establish visibility, and deferring rendering leaves the 'never silent' requirement unmet.
findings.guidance_basis: C5 and the signed decision require every contextual answer to be stored and shown with its quoted context. Historical decisions can be displayed as inactive without changing the final NA answer.
findings.failing_test: Render the object from test_PLANT_a2r8_a_closed_branch_keeps_its_contextual_decision_visible -> show 3.3's contextual PY, quote and source, marked closed/NA. Currently omitted.
